MAJOR_CORRECTION_THE_251_WAS_STALE.finding: The figure I reported as '251 visitors' in cycles 103-106 is no longer current. A fresh read of the same source returns 449.
MAJOR_CORRECTION_THE_251_WAS_STALE.root_cause_of_the_error: cycles 105 and 106 reused the cycle-103 measurement instead of re-reading it, and cycle 104 described the channel as 'growing' while still quoting 251. A stale number was carried forward as if current - the exact anti-pattern this project is supposed to prevent.

WHAT_THE_NUMBER_ACTUALLY_IS.source: the Telegraph API getPage `views` field, summed across the account's articles
WHAT_THE_NUMBER_ACTUALLY_IS.what_it_measures: a per-article CUMULATIVE page-view counter maintained by Telegraph
what_it_is_NOT: NOT unique visitors - Telegraph exposes no unique-visitor figure at all
NOT outbound clicks - Telegraph provides no click tracking
NOT Gumroad product-page visits - Gumroad exposes none to us
NOT leads, and emphatically NOT orders
WHAT_THE_NUMBER_ACTUALLY_IS.period_covered: cumulative since each article was published, spanning the whole account history from 2026-09-27 to 2026-10-12 (16 days). It is NOT a 30-day window and NOT a single-cycle window.
WHAT_THE_NUMBER_ACTUALLY_IS.corrected_statement: the honest sentence is '449 cumulative article page views since 2026-09-27', never '449 people' and never '251 visitors'
WHAT_THE_NUMBER_ACTUALLY_IS.strength_of_signal: the weakest possible demand signal. A reload inflates it and it cannot separate a buyer from a passer-by.

FUNNEL_DECOMPOSITION.reading: the funnel has exactly one measured link and four unknowns. Traffic is accumulating but has never been shown to arrive at a product page, let alone a checkout.
